Treating a bundle value or a gift value as a sale price
Treating a lowest-price offer as a verified fixed SKU price

layout.large_type: Wrap labels and grow rows; keep purchase action visible. Product images are unchanged and zoomable.

interactions.name: OpenProduct
interactions.trigger: Tap hero or a full product block
interactions.result: Open the exact product by stable product code; preserve shop scroll for return
interactions.failure: Retain current list and show retryable navigation feedback

interactions.name: HeroCarousel
interactions.result: Automatic native swiper,5000ms cadence; retain manual swipe and slim progress indicator; no visible play/pause control per explicit user annotation.
interactions.guards: Stop while page is hidden or hero is offscreen; respect reduced motion. A manual swipe resets the automatic cadence and does not leave an unresumable paused state.
interactions.preview: Autoplay enabled by default unless OS reduced motion is active. No play/pause DOM control.

interactions.name: DetailAnchors
interactions.trigger: Tap 商品, 详情 or 评价
interactions.result: Position within the same long page; scroll synchronizes selected tab; native capsule and sticky-header height are excluded from destination offset
interactions.must_not: Horizontally swipe the whole detail page or lose purchase selection

interactions.name: ViewOriginal
interactions.trigger: Tap any gallery or detail image
interactions.result: Open full original image, support enlargement and close/back; never crop away source words in the full viewer

interactions.name: SelectSku
interactions.trigger: Tap selector or 选择规格
interactions.result: Bottom sheet with verified SKU, source-qualified offer and quantity; confirm updates local selection; cancel retains last confirmed selection
interactions.guards: SKU ownership, version, current price, active state, integer quantity, stock and idempotency remain server-authoritative; preview does not invent stock

interactions.name: CheckoutAndResume
interactions.trigger: Tap 立即购买 after selection
interactions.result: Use existing native checkout. Guest logs in and returns to the same product/selection. Revalidate quote and inventory before order confirmation
interactions.guards: No charge from detail-page clicks; actual money tests require separately specified order, amount, count and stop condition

interactions.name: PurchasedReview
interactions.result: New backend review contract required: server-verified completed order and item ownership, actual author, text safety, pagination, deletion and authorised moderation
interactions.empty: 暂无评价; no fabricated score or review count
interactions.privacy: Do not repurpose private care records or community comments as product purchase reviews

interactions.name: OrdersAndRecords
interactions.result: Reuse existing owned orders and private care history; both old and new entry paths work; login and failed navigation recover

states.ui: Honest loading presentation; retain an already confirmed list when refreshing
Only verified published product information and live purchase capabilities
商品正在准备中; permit refresh and navigation
Specific retry, preserved existing content and selection
暂时缺货 with explanation; no order creation; other products remain browseable
商品已下架 with return to shop; no stale purchase action
Server refresh and user reconfirmation; preserve quantity as input but do not trust it

construction_slices: Approve the real-product visual draft and lock source-to-view mapping.
Update active PRD navigation and review acceptance items, then implement native navigation/package/login-return migration.
Implement source-backed native shop/detail layout, verified multi-image and detail-media management with controlled upload and publication.
Implement purchased-review backend and native list/composer with real safety and ownership validation.
Verify real product SKU, exact sale-price conditions, gifts, stock, pre-sale delivery, loyalty, shipping insurance and aftersales before versioned catalogue publication.
Verify on current-package hashes in WeChat Developer Tools and authorised iOS/Android devices, distinguishing synthetic layout from real interface and account evidence.
validation_boundary: HTML is a review artefact only; browser rendering and interactions are not native mini-program acceptance, product listing, business-rule activation, or payment evidence.
